name: Mesu to Kashita Jukujo!! ~Wakai Otoko no Seiyoku no Toriko ni Natta Conveni Obasan!!~
original_name: 牝と化した熟女！！～若い男の性欲の虜になったコンビニおばさん！！～
source:
Mrs. Katsura is the hot older woman who runs the convenience store. 
One night at a drinking party she hooks up with a young part-timer. 

It's been years since she felt like a woman. What a woman!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127064.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
桂夫人是经营便利店的性感年长女性。

某夜，她在饮酒聚会上与一名年轻兼职员工发生了关系。

她已经多年没有感受过作为女人的感觉了。作为女人，真正的感觉。
